About

From visual design to complete digital product experiences.

I’m a Web Developer and UX/UI Designer with 8+ years of experience creating websites, interfaces and digital products.

My career began in graphic design, where I developed a strong foundation in visual communication, composition and brand consistency. I then specialized in building and maintaining websites with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Joomla and Shopify.

As my work evolved, I incorporated UX research, information architecture, prototyping and interface design. Today, I integrate AI throughout my workflow—from research and ideation to content, design, development, debugging, testing and iteration.
